children: Zen Technologies
a leading provider of simulation based training solutions, is strengthening its global maritime simulation capabilities with the delivery and
installation of an Integrated Bridge and Engine Room Simulation solution at the International Navigation Training Center (ISNTC) in Manila, Philippines, through its wholly owned subsidiary,
ARI Simulation

Philippines is a global maritime powerhouse, supplying nearly one in every five deployed seafarers worldwide and playing a critical role in the international shipping industry. As maritime operations evolve with digitalisation, automation and increasingly complex onboard systems, investment in advanced training technologies is becoming essential to maintaining workforce competency, safety and global competitiveness. This creates a significant role for high-fidelity simulation in preparing the next generation of maritime professionals.
Integrated Bridge & Engine Room Simulation Solution | Key Advantages
Realistic, Full-Mission Training
: Replicates real-world vessel operations and engine room environments.
Integrated Bridge-to-Engine Training
: Enables coordinated training across navigation, propulsion and machinery operations.
Safer Training at Zero Operational Risk:
Practise critical manoeuvres, equipment failures and emergency scenarios in a controlled environment.
Stronger Decision-Making:
Develops situational awareness, operational judgement and crew coordination.
Emergency Preparedness:
Simulates engine failures, fire scenarios, collisions and other critical situations.
Competency Development
: Helps maritime professionals build practical skills aligned with operational and training requirements.
About Zen Technologies:

Zen Technologies is an India-based technology company specialising in combat training solutions, simulation systems and counter-drone technologies for defence and security forces. Through its portfolio of simulation and training solutions, the company supports realistic, technology-enabled training designed to enhance operational preparedness.
ARI Simulation

, a wholly owned subsidiary of Zen Technologies, specialises in simulation-based training solutions for the commercial maritime, offshore and naval sectors. Its portfolio spans bridge operations, engine room management, cargo handling, vessel traffic management and specialised maritime applications, complementing Zen Technologies’ broader capabilities in naval and defence simulation.
